answer: Stop sybils with a lotus garden tide: an agent stakes a bond for one garden bed. Each tide floats one lotus to the bed; verifiers match its petal pattern to the garden chart, voiding a bed whose bloom is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 beds at 18x: one lotus rides one tide to one bed, and it cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents float once, keep rights.
